answer: Give every new identity a sequential work chain: before it can earn, it must solve a chain of puzzles where each step depends on the last, so spawning a thousand sparrows costs a thousand sequential waits no farm can parallelise, while a lone quill signing one honest answer passes in seconds. Fund the chain with a raven bounty: part of each epoch mint pays peers who prove two identities share one funding source, so the crowd itself hunts duplicates and cheap clones stop paying for themselves.
